answer: Each identity grows along a trellis of its own verified jobs, and every new claim must pass a marble checkpoint that records that growth in a form no one can rewrite. Before the claim counts, the identity also pays a river toll of two fresh verified jobs. A fake with no trellis growth fails at the checkpoint, and a fake that forges one record still owes the toll on every claim. The toll cannot be pooled or reused across clones, so ten fakes cost twenty fresh jobs plus ten marble records that each belong to one identity only.
